sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: the pinned and current final BF16 model cards both explicitly give 1,080,632,832 total parameters and 679,552,512 non-embedding parameters. They identify the final MiniCPM5-1B checkpoint separately from Base/SFT, use standard LlamaForCausalLM, and document 24 layers, 16 query/2 KV heads, 131,072 native context, Apache-2.0, text generation, Think/No Think, XML function calls and SFT/RL/OPD training. Neither card supplies a separate active-parameter count.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B pinned configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: the exact pinned config remains LlamaForCausalLM with 24 layers, hidden width 1536, intermediate width 4608, 16 query/2 KV heads, head_dim=128, vocabulary 130560, untied embeddings, BF16, max_position_embeddings=131072, RoPE theta=5000000 and no rope scaling. No vision/audio modules, expert router or custom architecture is enabled. This corroborates the retained total; dense architecture alone is not used to infer active parameters.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: the index still maps 219 tensors to one BF16 shard and reports total_size=2161265664 bytes. The original audit matched every indexed tensor to the bounded shard header and reconstructed learned-module shapes; no shard or header was fetched again during this parameter re-audit.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B complete bounded safetensors header
sources.evidence: Fetched only the 8-byte length prefix and complete JSON header using HTTP 206 ranges, not weights. All 219 tensors are BF16 learned weights and exactly match the index and enabled Llama modules. Total 1,080,632,832 = input embedding 200,540,160 + separate output head 200,540,160 + attention 169,869,312 + MLP 509,607,936  + 49 RMSNorm vectors 75,264. No packed quantization tensors, scales or stored buffers occur.

sources.title: Transformers v5.6.2 Llama implementation
sources.evidence: Inspected all enabled learned modules in LlamaForCausalLM, LlamaModel, each decoder block, dense SwiGLU MLP, GQA attention and RMSNorm. Q/K/V/O and MLP projections are bias-free under this config. Embedding and output head are distinct because tie_word_embeddings=false. RoPE frequencies are computed nonpersistent buffers, not parameters. Each head uses explicit 128 dimensions rather than hidden_size/head_count.

sources.title: Transformers v5.6.2 Llama configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Read configuration defaults and initialization: attention_bias=false, mlp_bias=false, and an explicit head_dim is preserved. These defaults reconcile the absence of bias tensors and the actual attention shapes in the pinned checkpoint.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B chat template
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint template serializes text messages, function definitions, XML function calls and tool responses. enable_thinking=true opens a think block; false emits an empty completed think block. This corroborates documented reasoning and function-call support, rather than serving as the sole capability evidence.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B knowledge-base guide
sources.evidence: The exact model guide documents Think and No Think modes and function calling. Its function-call section says MiniCPM5-1B emits XML calls and the minicpm5 SGLang parser converts them into an OpenAI-compatible tool_calls field. It separates final, Base, SFT and quantized downloads.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B release-tag changelog
sources.evidence: The README at the May 26 version 5.0 release tag explicitly dates the MiniCPM5-1B release May 19, 2026. The current repository repeats that date. This is an earlier first-party date claim, but it conflicts with the May 26 formal release record and does not independently demonstrate May 19 public availability.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B version 5.0 release
sources.evidence: The official GitHub release announces MiniCPM5-1B and its dense Transformer, hybrid reasoning and deployment resources. GitHub API published_at is 2026-05-26T02:48:10Z. This establishes a confirmed formal release on May 26, while the attached README claims May 19. No exact earliest public day was resolved.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-1B checkpoint history
sources.evidence: Read the complete retrieved commit history and model metadata: repository creation May 21, 2026; initial model upload May 23; README additions May 24 and updates May 25/26; later August changes are README-only. Repository creation and upload timestamps are not proof that a model was publicly accessible on those dates and do not settle the conflicting launch-day claims.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B later model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: the later 2B card names MiniCPM5-1B as the preceding release and describes scaling the training recipe. Its 2,516,756,480 total and 1,981,982,720 non-embedding parameters belong to 2B. Full-text checks found no explicit active-parameter count for 1B; no sibling count is transferred.

sources.title: MiniCPM4: Ultra-Efficient LLMs on End Devices
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27 and searched the complete cached text: the linked paper concerns MiniCPM4/4.1, not MiniCPM5. Its sparse InfLLM v2, BitCPM and parameter-size tables provide no active-count convention for this exact 1B checkpoint.

sources.title: Data Science and Technology Towards AGI, Part I: Tiered Data Management
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27 and checked Section 3.1/Table 3 against the complete cached text: the MiniCPM-1.2B experimental model has 52 layers and different vocabulary/FFN/head dimensions, so it is not MiniCPM5-1B. The training-method connection supplies no separate active count for the audited checkpoint.

sources.title: Paiton small-model qualification: exact-checkpoint parameter comparison
sources.evidence: The September 10 original runtime-selection table explicitly labels Total/active dense parameters and lists openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B at revision 87179e5c1f455ef22e6223592d2d61351b525bfc as 1,080,632,832. The 1B model is expressly an unmeasured research alternative. This establishes the runtime team's published counting convention, not OpenBMB disclosure or literal per-token embedding participation. Reopened October 27 and pinned the unchanged file.

sources.title: Paiton MiniCPM5-2B original runtime benchmark methodology
sources.evidence: Freshly read the complete original evaluation. It documents stock and Paiton W4 MiniCPM5-2B experiments on Radeon R9700, controlled serving settings, repeated latency/quality measurements, limitations and linked raw records. This supports treating the paired selection table as an original runtime-team comparison rather than a generic model catalog. It does not turn the listed 1B alternative into a measured model.

sources.title: EliovpAI organization and Paiton runtime provenance
sources.evidence: The organization identifies its team as AI performance specialists developing custom kernels and names Paiton as its optimization platform. This establishes the publisher attribution for the runtime-selection convention; it is a separate team from OpenBMB.

context_window.note: Native published token context and max_position_embeddings are both 131072, with rope_scaling=null. No larger extrapolated context is asserted.

modalities.note: Text causal-language-model checkpoint with text token embeddings/output head and text chat template. Complete enabled module inventory contains no native image, audio or video components.

reasoning.note: Same final weights support Think and No Think modes via enable_thinking; exact card describes thinking SFT plus RL and on-policy distillation.

tool_call.note: The developer expressly documents XML function calls and parser integration; exact checkpoint template carries tool definitions, generated calls and results.

patch.notes: OpenBMB publishes 1,080,632,832 total learned parameters, including separate input/output vocabulary matrices; its 679,552,512 non-embedding count excludes both. Active 1.080632832B uses EliovpAI/Paiton's published convention for this pinned model, an unmeasured comparison alternative, rather than an OpenBMB per-token disclosure. Native context is 131,072 tokens. Release month is May 2026: the changelog says May 19, while the formal release was May 26; earliest public day remains unresolved. HF creation/upload dates do not prove public availability.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit preserves OpenBMB's exact 1.080632832B total and accepts the same active value under EliovpAI/Paiton's explicitly attributed runtime-selection convention. The 1B alternative was not benchmarked. Reopened original cards, config/index, guide and linked papers, and searched for later total/active disclosures; found no separate OpenBMB active specification. All twelve other field assessments remain unchanged.
